brd_json.Executive Summary: A lean 4-week validation scope focused strictly on Python and TypeScript GitHub pull requests. Eliminate on-prem complex deployments; validate developer willingness-to-pay via a $19/dev tier before enterprise sales.
brd_json.Problem & Opportunity: Developers ignore tools that slow down PR merges. The core bottleneck is speed: developers will abandon any bot that takes longer than 90 seconds to review a pull request.
brd_json.Technical Architecture: Serverless AWS Lambda / Google Cloud Run execution layer consuming GitHub webhooks. Single-pass LLM prompt with pre-computed AST filters to keep response times under 45 seconds.
brd_json.Go-to-Market Strategy: Launch on Hacker News and Product Hunt. Target YC early-stage founders and solo developers first; achieve 100 active repositories before hiring enterprise reps.
brd_json.Regulatory & Compliance Risk: Avoid HIPAA and SOC2 scope initially by explicitly forbidding analysis of confidential private healthcare repositories; focus on open-source and standard commercial SaaS.
brd_json.Financial Plan & Unit Economics: Operate within a $15,000 bootstrapped runway. Use prompt compression and batch embeddings to cap inference costs at $0.03 per reviewed commit.
